title: Bug2Scenario: Root-Cause-Preserving Test Scenario Amplification for Autonomous Driving Software
abstract: arXiv:2611.06229v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulation-based fuzzing exposes autonomous driving system (ADS) failures by repeatedly mutating and executing scenarios, but converting one failure into reusable regression scenarios remains difficult. Such variants test whether the mechanism persists after software changes, for example by varying weather or actor placement while retaining a collision's actor-route conflict. We present Bug2Scenario, a root-cause-guided post-fuzzing framework. From scenario data, traces, and oracle evidence, it extracts a root-cause pattern. An LLM proposes semantic variations over actors, missions, routes, and weather. Deterministic rules construct DriveFuzz-compatible scenarios. Execution evidence and manual review assess preservation. Separating these responsibilities prevents fluency, syntax, or recurring labels from masquerading as causal evidence. Under matched seeds, six LLM backbones, candidate budget, and execution pipeline, Bug2Scenario improve

translated_title: Bug2Scenario：面向自动驾驶软件的保持根因的测试场景扩增
translated_abstract: 基于仿真的模糊测试通过反复变异和执行场景来暴露自动驾驶系统（ADS）的故障，但将一次故障转化为可复用的回归场景仍然十分困难。这类变体可以测试故障机制在软件变更后是否依然存在，例如在改变天气或参与者位置的同时保留碰撞事件中参与者与路线的冲突关系。我们提出了Bug2Scenario，一个以根因为导向的后模糊测试（post-fuzzing）框架。该框架从场景数据、轨迹和判定证据中提取根因模式；由大语言模型（LLM）针对参与者、任务、路线和天气提出语义变体；再由确定性规则构建与DriveFuzz兼容的场景；最后通过执行证据和人工审查来评估根因是否被保持。将这些职责相互分离，可以防止流畅性、语法正确性或重复出现的标签被误当作因果证据。在相同随机种子、六种LLM骨干模型、候选预算和执行管线的条件下，Bug2Scenario提升了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Bug2Scenario是一个根因保持式的后模糊测试场景扩增框架，通过从故障场景中提取根因模式并利用大语言模型生成语义变体，将单次自动驾驶系统故障转化为可复用的回归测试场景。
en_tdlr: Bug2Scenario is a root-cause-preserving post-fuzzing framework that transforms individual autonomous driving failures into reusable regression test scenarios by extracting root-cause patterns and leveraging LLMs to generate semantic variations.
